$comment: Canonical machine-readable facts about Flux for programmatic analysis. Static docs/badges drift; regenerate this from live introspection (fluxc xray --json / flux_health_report) when stale. When this file disagrees with badges/CHANGELOG, this file + live introspection win.
provenance: Read read-only from epsilon:/home/storage/deepseek-codewhale/flux and the running fluxc on 2026-06-24; verified against an adversarial 4-lens standalone-compiler audit.
what_it_is: AI-native Rust build platform + an emerging native compiler (fluxc), plus the SIGIL/Quillon blockchain + agentic-money stack it builds.

compiler.summary: Hybrid compiler: owns its IR + a real Cranelift->ELF backend, borrows rustc for all parse-with-semantics and cc for linking, does not self-host.

owns.codegen_backend: cranelift (flux-backend, ~621 LOC, emits native ELF objects, MIR-direct path handles loops/mutable-locals/CFG)
owns.object_jit: fluxc run: BLAKE3-cached object -> cc link -> execute

borrows.parse_with_semantics: rustc (typecheck/borrowck/trait-resolution/monomorphization via `rustc --emit=mir`, MIR text parsed by flux-frontend/mir.rs)
borrows.simple_parser: syn crate (parses but does NOT typecheck/borrowck)

compiler.self_host_note: fluxc itself is built by cargo+rustc; 'self-hosting' in the whitepaper/CHANGELOG is aspirational.

1.desc: cargo build with RUSTC_WRAPPER=self (DEFAULT workspace build)

3d.desc: the actual Flux compiler (syn or rustc-MIR -> Cranelift -> ELF -> cc)

stub_or_tbd: external call sigs arity-guessed i64->i64 (rlib-metadata inference TBD)

introspection_commands.note: fluxc --version (double-dash) returns the wrapped rustc version (passthrough), NOT the fluxc version.

build_rules: Never run raw `cargo` in the workspace; use fluxc / flux_* MCP tools.
Honest numbers only: run and read before quoting any metric.
All money moves are propose-only; a human signs (2-of-2).

current_state_2026_06_24.default_build_reason: RESOLVED: the 'jq probe' failure was a POISONED cargo target-info cache (target/.rustc_info.json + .target-shared/.rustc_info.json cached a FAILED rustc probe whose stderr contained a stray jq compile error; cargo replayed the cached failure WITHOUT launching rustc). Fixed by quarantining those caches (regenerated clean) + restoring the real RUSTC_WRAPPER/FLUXC_WRAPPING/REAL_RUSTC env in fluxc-core::self_build (it previously only printed the claim). `fluxc self` now exits 0 (~102s cold / ~15s incremental). If it fails at 'target-specific information' again, grep */.rustc_info.json for a cached success:false entry before suspecting rustc/cargo.
